must_contain: Android Gradle plugin requires Java 17 to run
flutter_gradle_jdk_mismatch.log.root_cause: AGP 8 needs JDK 17 but the workflow installs Java 11 with actions/setup-java

flutter_pub_version_solving.log.root_cause: intl ^0.20.2 conflicts with intl 0.19.0 pinned by flutter_localizations (SDK)
flutter_pub_version_solving.log.fix: Use the SDK-pinned intl (intl: ^0.19.0 or any) or upgrade Flutter to an SDK that pins 0.20

flutter_analyze_failure.log.root_cause: CI runs flutter analyze --fatal-infos; three info-level lints fail the step
flutter_analyze_failure.log.fix: Fix the three lints (dart fix --apply + manual), run flutter analyze --fatal-infos locally

must_contain: can only install packages when your package.json and package-lock.json
node_npm_ci_lockfile.log.root_cause: package.json added zod / bumped typescript without regenerating package-lock.json
node_npm_ci_lockfile.log.fix: npm install with CI's npm major and commit package-lock.json

must_contain: applyDiscount › applies 10% discount for orders over $100
node_jest_failure.log.root_cause: applyDiscount returns 89.99 instead of 90 (rounding/logic change in discount code)
node_jest_failure.log.fix: Fix applyDiscount rounding (compare with diff); don't change the expectation unless intended

python_pytest_failure.log.root_cause: ledger/client.py imports httpx, which is not declared in requirements.txt
python_pytest_failure.log.fix: Add httpx to requirements.txt (runtime dependency) and re-run

docker_build_copy_failed.log.root_cause: Dockerfile COPYs dist/, a build output that is not in the build context (git-ignored / not built)
docker_build_copy_failed.log.fix: Multi-stage build: run npm run build in a builder stage and COPY --from=builder /app/dist

must_contain: Input required and not supplied: firebaseServiceAccount
missing_secret_env.log.root_cause: firebaseServiceAccount secret resolves to empty (missing secret or fork/Dependabot PR)
missing_secret_env.log.fix: Create/rename the secret; skip the deploy step for fork PRs

runner_out_of_memory.log.root_cause: next build was SIGKILLed by the OOM killer on the runner (exit 137)
runner_out_of_memory.log.fix: Reduce build memory (NODE_OPTIONS heap cap, fewer workers) or use a larger runner

must_contain: Exceeded timeout of 5000 ms for a test
flaky_timeout_test.log.root_cause: RatesClient test calls a real external API; connection reset makes it time out intermittently
flaky_timeout_test.log.fix: Mock the HTTP call (msw/nock) instead of hitting the real API

ruby_rspec_failure.log.root_cause: Invoice#total uses float arithmetic, so VAT comes out as 119.00000000000001
ruby_rspec_failure.log.fix: Use BigDecimal (or round to cents) in Invoice#total; don't loosen the expectation

must_contain: error CS8602: Dereference of a possibly null reference
dotnet_nullable_warnaserror.log.root_cause: CI builds with -warnaserror, so nullable warnings CS8602/CS8618 in Api fail the build
dotnet_nullable_warnaserror.log.fix: Add the null check in CartService and make Order.Customer required; build with -warnaserror locally

must_contain: Root composer.json requires php ^8.3 but your php version (8.2.27)
gitlab_composer_platform.log.root_cause: The job image is php:8.2-cli, but composer.json and the lock require PHP ^8.3
gitlab_composer_platform.log.fix: Use image php:8.3-cli in .gitlab-ci.yml (or set config.platform.php and re-lock for 8.2)

jenkins_go_test_failure.log.root_cause: The banker's-rounding change makes Convert round 108.305 up to 108.31 instead of 108.30
jenkins_go_test_failure.log.fix: Fix the rounding mode in convert (or update the expectation if the new rounding is intended)
